title: Settings
subtitle: The store's operational configuration — what customers see, where you ship, how you tax, which languages you publish in.

store.title: Store
store.intro: Who you are and how to reach you. This information is published on the legal notice and the contact page.

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.intro: Group the countries you ship to into zones, then decide which methods each zone offers and at what price. A country belongs to one zone only, so every customer sees exactly one set of options.

taxes.title: Taxes & VAT
taxes.intro: The VAT rates applied at checkout, country by country, and the reduced rates of some product categories. The calculation rules are fixed and listed below.

languages.title: Languages
languages.intro: The languages content can be translated into. French is the original language; the public site is offered in French and English.

savedBody.store: The legal notice and contact page show your details (public pages update within a few minutes).
savedBody.shipping: Checkout now offers the updated zones and rates.
savedBody.taxes: New orders use the updated rates. Past orders keep the VAT they were charged.
savedBody.languages: Content languages are up to date.

toast.pendingBody: Not live yet — save your changes to publish it.

errorsSummary.body: They are marked below. Nothing has been saved yet.

saveError.title: Your changes could not be saved

reasons.forbidden: Your role does not allow changing the settings. Ask an administrator.
reasons.invalid: A value was refused. Check the fields in this section, then try again.
reasons.unavailable: The server did not answer. Your changes are still here — try again in a moment.

ui.appliesOnSave: Goes live when you save the page.

errors.email: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number with digits only, spaces allowed (e.g. +33 1 23 45 67 89).
errors.postalFr: A French postal code has 5 digits.
errors.tooLong: Too long — shorten it to fit the limit.
errors.hours: Check the opening hours: each open day needs a start before its end.
errors.days: Enter whole days, with the maximum at least equal to the minimum.
errors.pricePositive: Enter a price above zero, or choose Free shipping.
errors.freeNeedsThreshold: Free shipping needs a minimum order amount.
errors.range: The maximum must be above the minimum.
errors.zoneNameTaken: Another zone already has this name.
errors.vatCountryTaken: This country already has a rate.
errors.vatNumber: Enter the number with its country code, e.g. FR12345678901.
errors.requiredShown: Fill this in, or don't show it to customers.
errors.reducedTaken: This country already has a reduced rate for this category.

business.title: Business identity
business.description: Published on the legal notice. The store name is the one customers see.

store.currency: Store currency: {{currency}}. Every price, shipping rate and order is in this currency.

contact.title: Contact details
contact.description: How customers and partners reach you.

address.title: Registered office
address.description: The address published on the legal notice — and on the contact page if you choose to show it.

legal.title: Publisher and hosting
legal.hostHint: The company hosting the website. If several providers host the application and its data, name the main one here.

public.title: Contact page
public.description: What customers read under “Other ways to reach us”.
public.showAddressHint: Only if customers can visit or collect their orders.

hints.storeName: The trading name customers know you by.
hints.shareCapital: Where the legal form requires it.
hints.registrationNumber: Number and register, e.g. RCS Paris 123 456 789.
hints.vatNumber: Only if the business is registered for VAT.
hints.businessEmail: Published on the legal notice. Leave empty to publish the customer service email.
hints.supportMessage: One short sentence, e.g. “Nous répondons sous un jour ouvré”.
hints.supportMessageEn: The same sentence for the English contact page.

hours.title: Support availability
hours.hint: When your team answers messages and calls. Shown on the contact page.

shipping.zonesHint: Each zone lists its countries first, then the methods customers there can choose.
shipping.restOfWorldLine: Every country not listed in another zone
shipping.noRates: No shipping method yet — customers here can't check out.
shipping.noCountries: No countries — this zone applies to nobody yet.
shipping.inactiveZone: Switched off: customers in these countries can't check out until the zone is on again.
shipping.inactiveWorld: Switched off: countries outside your other zones can't check out.

issues.title_one: {{count}} zone can't be used at checkout
issues.title_other: {{count}} zones can't be used at checkout
issues.noRates: {{zone}} is on but has no shipping method.
issues.noActiveRate: {{zone}} is on but all its methods are switched off.

empty.title: No shipping zones yet
empty.body: Create a zone for the countries you ship to, then add at least one shipping method so customers can check out.

kindHint.standard: Your everyday tracked delivery at a fixed price.
kindHint.express: A faster option customers pay more for.
kindHint.free: Offered automatically once the basket reaches an amount.
kindHint.pickup: Customers collect their order from the studio, free of charge.

checker.title: Check a destination
checker.description: See exactly what a customer in a given country is offered, including unsaved changes.
checker.via: {{country}} is in {{zone}}. Customers there can choose:
checker.viaWorld: {{country}} isn't listed in a zone, so {{zone}} applies:
checker.noZone: No zone covers {{country}} — customers there can't check out.
checker.inactive: {{country}} is in {{zone}}, which is switched off — customers there can't check out.
checker.noRate: {{country}} is in {{zone}}, but no method is switched on — customers there can't check out.

confirm.zoneBody_one: Customers in its {{count}} country will no longer be able to check out unless another zone covers them. Its {{rates}} shipping methods are deleted with it. You can still discard this before saving.
confirm.zoneBody_other: Customers in its {{count}} countries will no longer be able to check out unless another zone covers them. Its {{rates}} shipping methods are deleted with it. You can still discard this before saving.
confirm.rateBody: Customers in {{zone}} will no longer see this option at checkout. Orders already placed keep the shipping they paid for.

toast.zoneDuplicatedBody: The copy starts switched off and without countries — choose them now.

zoneSheet.description: A zone is a group of countries that share the same shipping methods and prices.
zoneSheet.name: Zone name
zoneSheet.nameHint: For you only — customers never see it.
zoneSheet.restOfWorldHint: Covers every country not listed in another zone.
zoneSheet.restOfWorldTaken: {{name}} already covers the rest of the world.
zoneSheet.restOfWorldBody: This zone catches every destination your other zones don't list. Switch it off to ship only to the countries you name.
zoneSheet.activeHint: When off, customers in these countries can't check out.

rateSheet.name: Name at checkout
rateSheet.nameHint: What customers read when choosing how to receive their order.
rateSheet.optional: Optional — the order amount above which this method becomes free.
rateSheet.freeFromHint: Free shipping appears at checkout from this basket total.
rateSheet.pickupFree: Pickup is always free for the customer.
rateSheet.conditionsHint: Leave empty for no limit. The method only appears when the order matches.
rateSheet.activeHint: When off, it is kept but hidden at checkout.

taxes.disclaimer: Have every rate confirmed by your accountant before launch (OSS registration, distance-selling thresholds, reduced rates).

missing.body: An active shipping zone serves {{countries}} with no active rate: those orders would pay no VAT. Add or switch on their rate.

rules.title: Rules applied at checkout
rules.description: Fixed for now: the database computes them on every order.

items.destination: The rate is the delivery country's; for an order with nothing shipped (gift card), the billing country's.
items.rounding: VAT is computed and rounded line by line.
items.shipping: Shipping is taxed at the delivery country's standard rate.
items.none: A country without an active rate pays no VAT (exports outside the EU).
items.giftCards: Buying a gift card carries no VAT: it is due when the card is spent.

checker.title: Check a destination
checker.description: What an order shipped to this country pays, with the rates shown here.
checker.missing: {{country}}: no rate — no VAT would be charged.
checker.export: {{country}}: outside the EU, no VAT charged (export).
checker.example: On an item at {{price}} including VAT, the VAT included is {{tax}}.

rates.title: Standard rates by country
rates.description: The rate applied to orders shipped to each country.
rates.rateHint: The country's standard VAT rate, as a percentage.
rates.fallback: A country that is missing or switched off pays no VAT.
rates.emptyBody: Without a rate, no order carries VAT. Add the rate of every country you ship to.
rates.dialogBody: Orders shipped to this country pay this rate.
rates.activeHint: Switched off, this country pays no VAT.
rates.deleteBody: Orders shipped to this country will pay no VAT. Past orders keep the VAT they were charged.

reduced.title: Reduced rates
reduced.description: Replace the standard rate for the products of one category, in one country. The category is chosen on the product page.
reduced.addBody: Applies to products in this category shipped to this country.

storefront.title: The public site is in French and English
storefront.body: Switching another language on opens content translation in it (products, pages, emails, member preferences); it is not added to the site until its pages exist.

enabled.title: Content languages
enabled.description: When on, they can receive translations and be chosen for an order or an account.

lang.effect: Switching a language off keeps its translations; they come back when you switch it on again.

status.failedTitle: The settings could not be loaded
status.failedBody: The server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
status.unavailableBody: This environment is not connected to the database: the store settings can neither be read nor changed here.

readOnly: Read only: your role can view the settings, not change them.
